_note: Seven Dorabella readings, reproduced verbatim from the comparison sheet 'Transcripts.pdf' in the public GitHub repository ShadowWolf387/DorabellaCipher (retrieved 2026-09-04). Line breaks follow the three physical lines of the manuscript; the five-character grouping in the source is cosmetic and is stripped. Items marked kind='decrypt' were published as claimed plaintexts rather than as transcriptions; under a monoalphabetic assumption a decrypt carries exactly the same information as a transcription (the two differ only by a relabelling), so they are usable here, but their provenance is weaker: a decrypt may have been silently adjusted to fit the claimed reading.
_provenance_warning: This is a secondary compilation by a partisan of one particular claimed solution. Character-level fidelity to each original publication has NOT been independently verified against the primary sources (Sams 1970; Roberts; Gaffney; Schmeh/MTC3; Ernst). Egress restrictions in this session blocked access to those primaries. Treat the individual readings as approximately-attributed, and the aggregate disagreement statistics as a lower bound on true transcription uncertainty.
